description: Scrape recipes from major recipe sites and food blogs. Search by keyword across supported sites, paste direct recipe URLs, point at category/search/tag pages, or walk a sitemap. The actor reads schema.org/Recipe JSON-LD first, with fallbacks for WP Recipe Maker, Tasty Recipes, Jetpack, and microdata. AllRecipes and a few other hard-blocked sites are not supported.

keywordIncludes.description: Drop recipes whose name and description do not contain this keyword.
keywordIncludes.title: Must contain keyword (optional)

listingUrls.description: Category, tag, or search-result pages. The actor extracts recipe links and follows page 2, 3, … where the site exposes a page parameter.
listingUrls.title: Listing page URLs (mode=byListing)

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted recipe records.
maxItems.title: Max recipes

maxPages.description: For search and listing modes, how many result pages to read per site or listing URL.
maxPages.title: Max pages per site/listing

maxTotalTimeMinutes.description: Drop recipes whose prep + cook time exceeds this many minutes.
maxTotalTimeMinutes.title: Maximum total time in minutes (optional)

minRating.description: Drop recipes with a rating below this value on a 0–500 scale (400 = 4.0/5).
minRating.title: Minimum rating (optional)

minRatingCount.description: Drop recipes with fewer ratings than this.
minRatingCount.title: Minimum rating count (optional)

mode.description: How to find recipes. Search by keyword is the simplest; URL and sitemap modes are best when you already know the pages.
enumTitles: Search by keyword — find recipes across supported sites
By URLs — scrape a list of direct recipe URLs
By listing pages — scrape category, tag, or search-result pages
By tag pages (legacy alias for byListing)
By sitemap — extract recipe URLs from sitemap.xml files
mode.title: Mode

proxy.description: No proxy is needed for the supported sites. Enable Apify Proxy only if you want to route requests through your own Apify proxy groups.
proxy.title: Apify Proxy (optional)

recipeUrls.description: Direct recipe-page URLs from any supported site or food blog. AllRecipes URLs are rejected as unsupported.
recipeUrls.title: Recipe URLs (mode=byUrls)

searchQuery.description: What to search for, e.g. `banana bread`, `vegan dinner`, or `chicken curry`.
searchQuery.title: Search query (mode=search)

site.description: Pick one site, or `all` to search every supported site. Search coverage varies by site; unsupported sites still work in byUrls/bySitemap modes.
site.title: Site to search (mode=search)

sitemapUrls.description: Sitemap.xml URLs. The actor walks sitemap indexes and keeps recipe-looking URLs.
sitemapUrls.title: Sitemap URLs (mode=bySitemap)

title: Recipe Scraper Input
